outcome: IV iron administration to iron-replete patients
cohort: The study included 347 pregnancies in patients diagnosed with b-thalassemia minor.
finding: The study found high rates of anemia (31% in third trimester, 7.6% at delivery) and postpartum hemorrhage (8.9%) in pregnant patients with b-thalassemia minor, with nearly half of IV iron administrations given to iron-replete individuals.
